source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.leaves: Even-pinnately compound; 10–20 leaflets, 1.2–2 cm wide, oblique, acuminate, entire
morphology_documented.fruit: Dry drupes, reddish to purple, 5–6 mm long, in much-branched panicles
morphology_documented.habitat: Widely planted ornamental; seedlings observed in Fort Worth woods in spring 1998

source_scope_note: Only traits documented in cited flora; null/omitted traits not inferred. Genus-key traits indicated where relevant.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Flora says native from Afghanistan to China and the Philippines; not a native Texas species
Naturalization of 1998 seedlings explicitly unresolved in flora
preservation: Additive research record; original species.json, photos, credits, and galleries unchanged
